Inside the proposed model +

Anomaly detection
Isolation Forest scores unusual observations. Source weights decrease as anomaly scores increase.

Forecasting
A planned LSTM model estimates future prices from historical windows. Forecast performance requires out-of-sample evaluation.

Aggregation
Weighted spot price = Σ(weight × source price) / Σ(weights). A quality score is distinct from a calibrated probability of accuracy.
